courseName: [ENG 101 Section 119] English for Academic Purposes I
title: Writing 1 Guidelines
description:
Task Description:
This writing aims to assess your understanding of the materials covered in class as well as your ability to express
your understanding combined with your opinion in a well-developed written response.
You will be given a single or a multi-part prompt on the writing day. The prompt will require you to present an
argument, recommendation, interpretation, or evaluation of and reaction to others’ ideas. You should support
these with the ideas/arguments/evidence/examples from reading texts and video/audio materials your instructor
has covered in class.
Task Specifications:
Grading : 15 points
Time limit : 2 class hours (110 minutes)
Word limit : A minimum of 500 words. The maximum word limit is 650 words. Students who exceed this
maximum word limit will be penalized. Students who write below a certain number of words will
also be penalized.
Number of : You should divide your response into at least 2 paragraphs and your paragraph division should be
paragraphs effective.
Borrowing : You should try to use a variety of borrowing methods (direct quote, paraphrase, summary,
methods synthesis). Using only direct quotations is not allowed. You should use quotations only when
necessary.
Number of : You should use at least two materials in your writing.
sources
References : You are expected to provide both in-text and end-text references for the sources you refer to.
Process:
▪ You must write your assignment in class; assignments written elsewhere will not be accepted.
▪ If you cannot finish writing within the time limit of two hours, you will NOT be allowed to finish it later, even
under the supervision of your instructor.
▪ You may bring your coursebook, the transcripts of the videos, and any other source material your instructor
assigns to the writing session so that you can make your citations. You may also use hard-copy dictionaries.
▪ You will not be able to use any electronic devices for any purpose (e.g. using phones to look up words,
bringing computers to type, or e-book readers/tablets to open the coursebook are not allowed).
▪ Teachers will keep the original papers and ask the students to take a clear photo of their writing to type it
at home. You will have two days after the writing session to type your assignment and upload it to Turnitin
without making any changes. You may only complete the reference list and correct mistakes related to
mechanics (i.e., spelling, punctuation, in-text and end-text references, etc.).
▪ Your instructor will grade your assignment using the ENG 101 Writing 1 Rubric out of 15 pts. and provide
written or oral feedback on your writing.
ENG 101
Writing 1 Guidelines for Students
-- 1 of 2 --
Paper Formatting:
Format your assignment as follows:
▪ Write your name and ID number at the top left corner of the first page
▪ Set all margins to 2.5 cm
▪ Use an appropriate font type and size
▪ Use double-spacing and left-justification for all text
▪ Indent the first lines of all paragraphs, with no extra spaces between paragraphs
▪ Insert the page number in the top right corner
▪ Start the reference list on a new page
▪ Format the reference list according to APA 7 guidelines
